sections.voiceover: Rutgers just stunned Penn State with a 25-24 win at Beaver Stadium on November 21, 2026.
What led to the game-winning backward pitch from Antwan Raymond to Ben Black near the goal?
But the real drama unfolded after Raymond rushed for 101 yards and two massive touchdowns.
The game-winning lateral play finally snapped their long-standing losing drought against the Nittany Lions.
Cam Wallace opened the scoring with a 56-yard play, but Rutgers secured the historic win.
